summary.headline: Astrological Consultation Chapters 97–116
summary.text: Astrological consultation chapters 97–116 on seeking, friendship, death, rank, action, childbearing, accidents, foreign death, war, possessions, inheritances, conception, the asker’s question, and whether a matter will conclude. The entries cite the lots of fortune, planetary rulers and places, Saturn and Mercury, and authorities including Dorotheus, Ptolemy, Valens, and Eleutherius.
